prompt_for_image_ai:
Create ONE flat vector landing sticker.

SIZE LOCK — IDENTICAL ON EVERY RIASEC LETTER (R, I, A, S, E, C):
- Canvas: exactly 1024px wide × 1024px tall. Fill entire canvas with solid paper #FDFCF8. No transparency. No black background.
- Sticker frame: exactly 780px OUTER WIDTH × 640px OUTER HEIGHT. Not wider. Not narrower. Not taller. Not shorter.
- Aspect ratio of the frame is fixed at 780:640. Letter S must use this exact same height and width as letters R and C.
- Corner radius ~48px. Border stroke ~10px lavender #B39DDB.
- Frame centered: left margin 122px, right margin 122px, top margin 192px, bottom margin 192px.
- Interior fill #FDFCF8.

HEIGHT LOCK: the frame outer height is 640px. Character head sits near the top inner border (~24px padding). Character waist and props are flush to and cropped by the INNER bottom border. Character fills the full interior height — no floating, no short figure with empty paper above and below.

LARGE LETTER LOCK (match gold R, S, C): left half, bold rounded SANS-SERIF block capital S. Fill #9575CD. Thin white inner offset stroke. Thick dark outer outline #2D2D2D. Letter height about 420px, vertically centered.

CORNER BADGE: ~56px circle bottom-right inside frame, small capital S, lavender fill, same sans style.

CHARACTER: ONE person only. Young Guardian, medium brown skin, dark hair in low puff bun, thin 2px outline #2D2D2D, flat fills, minimal black dot eyes. Faces inward-left toward S. Lavender cardigan #9575CD over light top. Left hand: welcoming gesture toward letter. Right arm: slim clipboard — back or edge toward viewer, not a full checklist page facing camera. Optional tiny heart speech-bubble. Waist flush to bottom border.

Style: KursoKo questionnaire unDraw flat vector. Minimal props.
